# Bitcoin Friesland

> Bitcoin Friesland (Frisian: Bitcoin Fryslân) is a volunteer community that
> promotes Bitcoin adoption and education in the province of Friesland, the
> Netherlands. The site is informational only and does not give financial advice.

## About
- Name: Bitcoin Friesland / Bitcoin Fryslân
- Region: Friesland (Fryslân), Netherlands
- Languages: Dutch (nl), English (en), Frisian (fy)
- Contact: info@bitcoinfriesland.com
- Community chat: https://t.me/bitcoinfriesland

## Events
- NodeRunners Conference 2026: Saturday 19 September 2026, 11:00-18:00, Koepelgevangenis Arnhem. https://conf2026.noderunners.network/
- Discount: code BITCOINFRIESLAND gives 10% off NodeRunners Conference 2026 tickets. The code is exclusive for the Bitcoin Friesland community and valid until the conference. Ticket link with the code applied: https://conf2026.noderunners.network/BITCOINFRIESLAND
- Past event: Bitcoin Friesland BBQ - Meat the Resistance took place Friday 14 August 2026 at Vliegveld Drachten in Drachten. Details: https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/evenementen/bitcoin-bbq-meat-the-resistance-drachten.html

## Supporter programme
- Participation in Bitcoin Friesland and its Telegram and Signal groups remains free.
- An individual supporter contributes the current satoshi value of EUR 21 for one year; payment is in sats only.
- Supporter benefits: 21 Bitcoin Friesland stickers, event discount codes, and a supporter tag in Telegram and Signal.
- The signup form records contact, payment timing and sticker delivery preferences. It is a request, not an automatic payment or active membership.
- Support does not buy influence, editorial control, exclusivity or an endorsement by Bitcoin Friesland.
